note: Alberta Parks campground in Kananaskis, 45 km southwest of Longview on Hwy 541 and 12 km south on the Forestry Trunk Road, run by Kananaskis Campground Services. Sites in lodgepole pine by Cataract Creek. Firewood sold by the campground manager; drinking water and a sani-dump at Highwood House. --Claude
